headline: Financial Times: Greece is strongly returning to the investment map - The stock exchange attracts foreign capital
summary: The MSCI upgrade, interest in Greek banks and prospects of new acquisitions are changing the picture of the Greek economy, according to the Financial Times. The Athens stock exchange is attracting foreign capital.
why: MSCI index classifications determine how much passive international capital flows into a market. Greek banks are significant listed financial institutions in the Athens market.
